newsitem.title: USA: Phoenix Shannon board members resign.
newsitem.headline: Phoenix Shannon board members resign.

text.p: Phoenix Shannon PLC said on Friday that three board members had resigned and that it has appointed two independent management consultants to review business operations.
The new board consists of four of the seven members who previously served and five new members elected by the board, the company said.

The new members of the board of directors are C. Keith Hartley, Harold L. Purkey, Philip Platek, Nico P. Pronk and Benjamin Swirsky. Messrs. Hartley, Purkey and Platek are Managing Partners of Forum Capital Markets, L.P.

Mr. Pronk is president of Noble International Investments, Inc., a full- service investment banking firm serving as the company's investment banker since April 1996. Mr. Swirsky is the president and chief executive officer of Slater Steel Inc, a diversified industrial holding company.

The existing directors who remain on the board consist of Ola Johansson, Phoenix Shannon's chief executive; Brian Boland, Phoenix Shannon's chief financial officer; H. George Wolfe, Jr., president of Phoenix Shannon's Ney Dental International subsidiary; and Keith Westrich, managing director of an Irish business consulting firm.
